description:
**Learning & Development Specialist**

Unlock your potential with Dassault Systèmes, a global leader in Scientific Software Engineering as a **Learning & Development Specialist in Pune, Maharashtra!**
  
  
**Role Description & Responsibilities:**

In this role you will be Defining and deploying unique learning experiences, including skills Learning needs assessments, innovative solutions, content, certifications, and programs, for targeted internal audiences, with the goal of developing and empowering the workforce of the future.

This role sits at the crossroads of learning design, program coordination, and community building. You will work hand-in-hand with a global team, contributing both to R&D-driven learning initiatives and to broader cross-functional programs, while maintaining strong local anchoring in India.

**Learning Program Design & Development**

* Assess development needs (through skills assessments, surveys, interviews, focus groups, and communication with people managers and key leadership) to formulate skills development plans and define priorities by organization and geography
* Design and develop unique learning solutions and programs that foster social learning and learning-by-doing, leveraging both in-house and sourced content
* Create and maintain learning materials, guides, and take-away resources in innovative formats (online and/or in-person), ensuring strong instructional quality throughout
* Design learning experiences integrating AI learning coaches and emerging learning technologies
* Position and promote digital learning as a strategic lever for individual performance and rapid skill development

**Program Coordination & Project Management**

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned learning projects, from scoping to final delivery, working with business stakeholders across an international perimeter
* Analyze briefs, clarify needs, and define the scope and learning objectives of each program
* Ensure instructional consistency, content quality, and on-time delivery at every stage of the project
* Organize and facilitate exchanges with subject matter experts to collect, structure, and formalize content; participate in project progress reviews
* Manage the full learning and certification portfolio process, ensuring quality standards and lifecycle management.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (training project managers, HR partners, Career & Performance, People Care) and external providers.

**Community Building & Ecosystem Management**

* Orchestrate and animate the learning community: learners, content contributors (SMEs and Learning Path owners), vendors, mentors, and trainers
* Advise and guide employees and managers; facilitate workshops and sessions to strengthen skills, competencies, and knowledge aligned with company needs
* Manage vendor engagement with business teams and support integration of external content within the company curriculum, culture, and values
* Investigate and resolve learner support queries.

**Measurement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor and support budget tracking, training records, attendance, assessment results, and retraining requirements
* Measure the impact of learning solutions and evaluate experience quality (through assessments, surveys, retrospectives, and feedback); adjust approach as needed
* Maintain active knowledge of the latest trends, tools, and benchmarks in L&D and AI applied to learning
* Proactively propose evolutions in instructional formats, design methods, and tools used; contribute to the continuous improvement of processes

**Qualifications:**

* Over 5 years of experience in Learning & Development, instructional design, or learning program management or in technical field
* Proven track record designing and coordinating learning programs in a tech-driven, international environment
* Experience working in or with cross-functional global teams (US / India / France or equivalent) is a strong advantage
* Bachelor’s degree in Educational Technology, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  

**What is in it for you?**

* Work for one of the biggest software companies in Europe
* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Opportunities for personal development and career progression

-----------------------

As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. The focus of this role will be to support, maintain and continuously enhance DNV’s global HR application landscape and participate in GSS IT projects and initiatives related to HR processes.
  
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will work closely with the HR community, IT teams and external partners, ensuring alignment between business requirements, application capabilities and the overall DNV system landscape.

DNV utilizes Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud across several HR processes, together with related PaaS services and other integrated HR solutions. For this position, we are particularly looking for strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), combined with broader hands-on experience across Oracle Fusion HCM.

The position combines application management, functional and technical consulting, configuration, integrations, operational support and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute both to stable day-to-day operations and to initiatives further developing our global HR technology landscape.
  
Be part of our long-term journey to continuously develop and improve the global HR IT landscape at DNV.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will:

* Ensure stable, reliable and well-performing Oracle Fusion HCM applications and services.
* Provide functional and technical application support, including analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex application issues.
* Configure, maintain and continuously improve Oracle Fusion HCM functionality based on business requirements.
* Analyze HR business requirements and translate them into appropriate functional and technical solutions.
* Support integrations between Oracle Fusion HCM and other internal and external systems.

**Why this role matters**

Our HR application landscape supports critical HR processes globally. As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will contribute directly to the stability, development and continuous improvement of these solutions.

You will work at the intersection of HR processes, Oracle Fusion HCM and technology, helping translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting the continued evolution of DNV’s global HR technology landscape.

Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

**Must have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud, including application configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement.
* Strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), including configuration and integrations with other systems.
* Hands-on experience with additional Oracle Fusion HCM areas such as Core HR, Compensation,
* Benefits, Security, Talent or other HCM modules.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL).
* Experience working with REST APIs and system integrations.
* Experience with SQL for analysis and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of end-to-end HR business processes and their implementation within HR technology solutions.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective functional and technical solutions.
* Experience with standard IT application support processes, including incident, request and change handling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently take ownership of topics and drive them through to completion.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple activities and deliver against agreed timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, functions and organizational boundaries.
* Willingness to continuously learn and keep up with changes within the Oracle Fusion HCM platform.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Oracle HCM reporting, extracts and related integration technologies.
* Experience with Oracle PaaS services and extensions.
* Experience participating in Oracle Fusion HCM implementations, rollouts or major enhancement initiatives.
* Experience working within a global HR technology or enterprise application environment.
    
  Personal qualities

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Is self-driven, proactive and well organized.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Has a hands-on and pragmatic approach to problem solving.
* Is comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a global team.
* Is customer and business oriented and able to understand HR needs beyond purely technical requirements.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Is collaborative and able to build strong working relationships across organizational and cultural boundaries.
* Is curious and motivated to continuously learn and develop.

We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.

Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV.

Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well-integrated team is a well-functioning team.

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.
